name: Vintage tractor (first pass)
description: First-pass farm-comparison tractor. Joints: Joint_Wheel_RL/RR/FL/FR (spin about local Z), Joint_Steer_FL/FR (steer about Y), Joint_Hitch, Joint_SeatAttach. Clip ArticulationProbe (4 s): rear 1 rev, front 2 rev, steer 0 -> +25 -> -25 -> 0; closed loop. Palette-derived matte paint/rubber, muted metal fittings.
brief: Compact vintage red-orange tractor per inputs/reference.png: large lugged rear wheels, small front wheels, red hubs, exposed dark seat and steering wheel, front grille, upright exhaust. Named wheel/steer pivots, hitch and seat references, ArticulationProbe clip.
